_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Evidence-based evaluation of completed agent tasks, implementations, documents, skill upgrades, and other deliverables…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "score this completed agent task against the original request, changed files, tests, and remaining risks before we call it done"
cases.context: The agent has access to the evaluation skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is evaluation the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes evaluation as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against methodology, debugging, best-practice
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the evaluation workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore evaluation
Does not route to methodology, debugging, best-practice when the evaluation scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence
